column7: The cup has a crack.
column9: To split, crack: 裂開, 裂縫 "crack", 破裂 "burst", 分裂, 裂痕. Something breaks into parts along a line. 裂 has 衣 "cloth" under 列 "row", for the sound (liè, the same): cloth torn apart.

column3: To drench, get wet: 淋雨 "get rained on", 淋湿 "soak", 淋浴 "take a shower", 淋水. It means being wetted by liquid falling on you. 淋 has 氵 "water" and 林 for the sound (lín, the same).
column6: Wǒ méi dài sǎn, lín le yī shēn yǔ.
column7: I had no umbrella and got soaked in the rain.
column9: To drench, get wet: 淋雨 "get rained on", 淋濕 "soak", 淋浴 "take a shower", 淋水. It means being wetted by liquid falling on you. 淋 has 氵 "water" and 林 for the sound (lín, the same).

column3: To face; to be about to: 面临 "face (a challenge)", 临时 "temporary, at short notice", 临走 "just as one leaves", 光临 "honored arrival" (欢迎光临 "welcome" at shops).
column6: Lín zǒu qián, tā bǎ mén guān hǎo le.
column7: Before leaving, he closed the door properly.
column9: To face; to be about to: 面臨 "face (a challenge)", 臨時 "temporary, at short notice", 臨走 "just as one leaves", 光臨 "honored arrival" (歡迎光臨 "welcome" at shops). 臨 shows an eye 臣 looking down at things 品.

column3: The small hours, from just after midnight until dawn: 凌晨两点, 凌晨三点. Midnight to 5 a.m. is "凌晨"; 清晨 is "early morning" after dawn. 凌 has 冫 "ice", for cold; 晨 has 日 "sun" and 辰 for the sound (chén, the same).
column6: Tā língchén liǎng diǎn cái shuì.
column7: He didn't go to sleep until 2 a.m.
column9: The small hours, from just after midnight until dawn: 凌晨兩點, 凌晨三點. Midnight to 5 a.m. is "凌晨"; 清晨 is "early morning" after dawn. 凌 has 冫 "ice", for cold; 晨 has 日 "sun" and 辰 for the sound (chén, the same).

column3: Flexible, nimble, agile: 头脑灵活, 手脚灵活, 灵活运用 "use flexibly". It describes fingers, a mind or an approach that adapts easily. 灵 "spirit, quick" + 活 "alive". 活 has 氵 "water".
column6: Tā de tóunǎo hěn línghuó.
column7: He has a quick, flexible mind.
column9: Flexible, nimble, agile: 頭腦靈活, 手腳靈活, 靈活運用 "use flexibly". It describes fingers, a mind or an approach that adapts easily. 靈 "spirit, quick" + 活 "alive". 活 has 氵 "water".

column3: Part, component of a machine: 汽车零件, 更换零件, 缺零件. It is a piece that is put together with others. 零 "small odd bits" has 雨 "rain" over 令, which also gives the sound of 冷 and 领. 件 shows a person 亻 and an ox 牛 that is cut up.
column6: Zhè tái jīqì quē yī ge língjiàn.
column7: This machine is missing a part.
column9: Part, component of a machine: 汽車零件, 更換零件, 缺零件. It is a piece that is put together with others. 零 "small odd bits" has 雨 "rain" over 令, which also gives the sound of 冷 and 領. 件 shows a person 亻 and an ox 牛 that is cut up.

column3: Retail: 零售商, 零售价, 零售业, as against 批发 "wholesale". It is selling in small quantities straight to buyers. 售 shows a bird 隹 and a mouth 口, a seller who calls out.
column4: 这家店只做零售，不做批发。
column5: 這家店只做零售，不做批發。
column6: Zhè jiā diàn zhǐ zuò língshòu, bù zuò pīfā.
column7: This shop only does retail, not wholesale.
column9: Retail: 零售商, 零售價, 零售業, as against 批發 "wholesale". It is selling in small quantities straight to buyers. 售 shows a bird 隹 and a mouth 口, a seller who calls out.

column3: Territory of a state: 国家领土, 领土完整 "territorial integrity", 领土争议 "territorial dispute". Land that belongs to a country. 领 first meant the neck or collar (it has 页 "head") and 令 gives the sound; 土 is earth.
column4: 这座岛是这个国家的领土。
column5: 這座島是這個國家的領土。
column6: Zhè zuò dǎo shì zhège guójiā de lǐngtǔ.
column7: This island is the territory of this country.
column9: Territory of a state: 國家領土, 領土完整 "territorial integrity", 領土爭議 "territorial dispute". Land that belongs to a country. 領 first meant the neck or collar (it has 頁 "head") and 令 gives the sound; 土 is earth.

column3: Leader, a respected head of a nation, party or movement: 精神领袖, 学生领袖, 领袖气质. Literally "collar and sleeve", the parts of a garment you take hold of. 领 "collar" has 页 "head"; 袖 has 衤 "clothes".
column6: Tā shì xuésheng lǐngxiù.
column7: He is a student leader.
column9: Leader, a respected head of a nation, party or movement: 精神領袖, 學生領袖, 領袖氣質. Literally "collar and sleeve", the parts of a garment you take hold of. 領 "collar" has 頁 "head"; 袖 has 衤 "clothes".

column3: Gift, often one given in business or as a souvenir: 礼品店, 赠送礼品, 礼品卡 "gift card". 礼物 is the everyday word for a present; 礼品 is more formal or commercial. 礼 has 礻 "altar" and 品 is three mouths, "goods".
column6: Zhè shì gōngsī sòng de lǐpǐn.
column7: This is a gift from the company.
column9: Gift, often one given in business or as a souvenir: 禮品店, 贈送禮品, 禮品卡 "gift card". 禮物 is the everyday word for a present; 禮品 is more formal or commercial. 禮 has 礻 "altar" and 品 is three mouths, "goods".

column3: To slip away, slide: 溜走, 溜出去 "sneak out", 溜进来, 溜滑梯 "slide down a slide". It is a quick, quiet move. 溜 has 氵 "water", for something smooth, and 留 for the sound (liū, liú).
column6: Xiǎotōu cóng hòumén liūzǒu le.
column7: The thief slipped away through the back door.
column9: To slip away, slide: 溜走, 溜出去 "sneak out", 溜進來, 溜滑梯 "slide down a slide". It is a quick, quiet move. 溜 has 氵 "water", for something smooth, and 留 for the sound (liū, liú).

column3: To skate: 溜冰场 "skating rink", 溜冰鞋 "skates", 去溜冰. 溜 "glide" + 冰 "ice". 冰 has 冫 "ice" and 水 "water", frozen water.
column6: Dōngtiān wǒmen qù liūbīng.
column7: In winter we go skating.
column9: To skate: 溜冰場 "skating rink", 溜冰鞋 "skates", 去溜冰. 溜 "glide" + 冰 "ice". 冰 has 冫 "ice" and 水 "water", frozen water.

column3: To keep as a memento: 拍照留念, 合影留念 "take a group photo as a keepsake", 留念品. It is at the end of the phrase, saying why: 在这里合影留念. 念 shows 今 "now" over 心 "heart": keeping the moment in mind.
column6: Wǒmen zài ménkǒu héyǐng liúniàn.
column7: We took a group photo at the entrance as a keepsake.
column9: To keep as a memento: 拍照留念, 合影留念 "take a group photo as a keepsake", 留念品. It is at the end of the phrase, saying why: 在這裡合影留念. 念 shows 今 "now" over 心 "heart": keeping the moment in mind.

column3: A final particle like 了, with a friendly, light tone, often on announcing something or a mild warning: 我先走喽!, 好喽!, 吃饭喽! It is spoken and informal, and sounds lively. 喽 has 口 "mouth" for a spoken sound and 娄 for the sound. The tone is neutral.
column6: Wǒ xiān zǒu lou!
column7: I'm off first!
column9: A final particle like 了, with a friendly, light tone, often on announcing something or a mild warning: 我先走嘍!, 好嘍!, 吃飯嘍! It is spoken and informal, and sounds lively. 嘍 has 口 "mouth" for a spoken sound and 婁 for the sound. The tone is neutral.

column3: To hug, hold in one's arms: 搂着, 搂住, 搂抱, 搂在怀里. It is an embrace with the arms around someone. 搂 has 扌 "hand" and 娄 for the sound (lǒu, lóu), which is also in 喽.
column6: Māma lǒu zhe háizi.
column7: Mom holds the child in her arms.
column9: To hug, hold in one's arms: 摟著, 摟住, 摟抱, 摟在懷裡. It is an embrace with the arms around someone. 摟 has 扌 "hand" and 婁 for the sound (lǒu, lóu), which is also in 嘍.

column3: Dew; "to show, reveal": 露水 "dew", 露营 "camp", 露天 "open-air", 露出 "show", 暴露 "expose". 露 has 雨 "rain" and 路 for the sound (lù, the same): moisture that falls from the sky.
column4: 早上草地上有很多露水。
column5: 早上草地上有很多露水。
column6: Zǎoshang cǎodì shàng yǒu hěn duō lùshuǐ.
column7: In the morning there is a lot of dew on the grass.
column9: Dew; "to show, reveal": 露水 "dew", 露營 "camp", 露天 "open-air", 露出 "show", 暴露 "expose". 露 has 雨 "rain" and 路 for the sound (lù, the same): moisture that falls from the sky.

column3: Street light: 路灯, 路灯亮了, 一排路灯. 路 "road" + 灯 "lamp". 路 has 足 "foot" and 各; 灯 has 火 "fire" and 丁 for the sound.
column6: Tiān hēi le, lùdēng liàng le.
column7: It got dark and the street lights came on.
column9: Street light: 路燈, 路燈亮了, 一排路燈. 路 "road" + 燈 "lamp". 路 has 足 "foot" and 各; 燈 has 火 "fire" and 登 for the sound (dēng, the same).

column3: Mung bean: 绿豆汤 "sweet mung bean soup", a cooling summer dessert, 绿豆糕, 绿豆沙. 绿 "green" has 纟 "silk" and 录, which is also the sound part in 录 (lǜ, lù). 豆 was a food dish on a stand, later "bean".
column6: Xiàtiān hē lǜdòu tāng hěn shūfu.
column7: In summer, mung bean soup is refreshing.
column9: Mung bean: 綠豆湯 "sweet mung bean soup", a cooling summer dessert, 綠豆糕, 綠豆沙. 綠 "green" has 糹 "silk" and 彔, which is also the sound part in 錄 (lǜ, lù). 豆 was a food dish on a stand, later "bean".

column3: Brief, sketchy; omit; slightly: 省略 "omit", 简略, 忽略, 略懂 "know a little", 略有不同 "slightly different", 策略 "strategy". Before a one-syllable verb it means "a little". 略 has 田 "field" and 各 for the sound: to walk around a field and sketch it.
column6: Wǒ lüè dǒng yīdiǎn Rìyǔ.
column7: I know a little Japanese.
column9: Brief, sketchy; omit; slightly: 省略 "omit", 簡略, 忽略, 略懂 "know a little", 略有不同 "slightly different", 策略 "strategy". Before a one-syllable verb it means "a little". 略 has 田 "field" and 各 for the sound: to walk around a field and sketch it.

column3: Army, the land forces: 陆军, 陆军官校. Along with 海军 and 空军 it is one of the three branches. 陆 "land" has 阝 "mound" and 击 for the sound. 军 is "army".
column6: Tā zài lùjūn fúyì.
column7: He serves in the army.
column9: Army, the land forces: 陸軍, 陸軍官校. Along with 海軍 and 空軍 it is one of the three branches. 陸 "land" has 阝 "mound" and 坴 for the sound (lù, the same). 軍 is "army".

column3: To discuss; theory; per: 讨论 "discuss", 论文 "thesis", 理论 "theory", 无论 "no matter", and "by the unit": 论斤卖 "sold by the jin". 论 has 讠 "speech" and 仑, whose sound it keeps (lùn). 仑 also gives 轮.
column6: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ shì lùn jīn mài de.
column7: These fruits are sold by weight.
column9: To discuss; theory; per: 討論 "discuss", 論文 "thesis", 理論 "theory", 無論 "no matter", and "by the unit": 論斤賣 "sold by the jin". 論 has 言 "speech" and 侖, whose sound it keeps (lùn). 侖 also gives 輪.

column3: To take turns: 我们轮流开车, 轮流值日 "take turns on duty", 轮流休息. Each person does it in order. 轮 "wheel" has 车 "cart" and 仑 for the sound (lún, the same); 流 "flow".
column6: Wǒmen lúnliú kāichē.
column7: We take turns driving.
column9: To take turns: 我們輪流開車, 輪流值日 "take turns on duty", 輪流休息. Each person does it in order. 輪 "wheel" has 車 "cart" and 侖 for the sound (lún, the same); 流 "flow".

column3: To be outdated, fall behind: 落伍了, 想法落伍, 思想落伍. People who don't keep up with the times. 伍 shows a person 亻 and 五 "five", a squad of soldiers; 落伍 is to drop out of the ranks.
column6: Zhè zhǒng shǒujī yǐjīng luòwǔ le.
column7: This type of phone is already outdated.
column9: To be outdated, fall behind: 落伍了, 想法落伍, 思想落伍. People who don't keep up with the times. 伍 shows a person 亻 and 五 "five", a squad of soldiers; 落伍 is to drop out of the ranks.

column3: To hire, accept an employee, or a manuscript: 被录用, 录用通知 "offer notice", 录用新人. It is the final decision after an interview. For admission after an exam, 录取 is used. 录 has 彐 and 氺.
column6: Tā bèi zhè jiā gōngsī lùyòng le.
column7: He was hired by this company.
column9: To hire, accept an employee, or a manuscript: 被錄用, 錄用通知 "offer notice", 錄用新人. It is the final decision after an interview. For admission after an exam, 錄取 is used. 錄 has 釒 "metal" and 彔 for the sound (lù, the same).

column3: Hemp, flax; "numb": 脚麻了 "my foot has gone numb", 麻烦 "trouble", 麻辣 "numbing-spicy", 麻将 "mahjong", 芝麻 "sesame", 麻醉 "anesthesia". 麻 shows hemp plants 林 in a shed 广.
column6: Wǒ zuò tài jiǔ, jiǎo má le.
column7: I sat too long and my foot has gone numb.
column9: Hemp, flax; "numb": 腳麻了 "my foot has gone numb", 麻煩 "trouble", 麻辣 "numbing-spicy", 麻將 "mahjong", 芝麻 "sesame", 麻醉 "anesthesia". 麻 shows hemp plants 林 in a shed 广.

column3: Careless, sloppy: 做事马虎, 不能马虎, 马马虎虎 "so-so; careless". It describes a person who doesn't pay attention to details. Written 马 "horse" and 虎 "tiger" for no clear reason. The second syllable is neutral.
column6: Tā zuòshì tài mǎhu le.
column7: He is too careless in his work.
column9: Careless, sloppy: 做事馬虎, 不能馬虎, 馬馬虎虎 "so-so; careless". It describes a person who doesn't pay attention to details. Written 馬 "horse" and 虎 "tiger" for no clear reason. The second syllable is neutral.

column3: To bury: 埋在土里, 埋葬 "bury (a dead person)", 埋头 "bury oneself in", 埋伏 "ambush". In 埋怨 "to blame" it is read mán. 埋 has 土 "earth" and 里.
column4: 小狗把骨头埋在院子里。
column5: 小狗把骨頭埋在院子裡。
column6: Xiǎogǒu bǎ gǔtou mái zài yuànzi lǐ.
column7: The puppy buried the bone in the yard.
column9: To bury: 埋在土裡, 埋葬 "bury (a dead person)", 埋頭 "bury oneself in", 埋伏 "ambush". In 埋怨 "to blame" it is read mán. 埋 has 土 "earth" and 里.

column3: To pay the bill: 我来买单, 请买单. It is said in a restaurant, and also means "I'm treating". Figuratively 不买单 is "not buying it".
column6: Jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè, wǒ lái mǎidān.
column7: Today it's my treat; I'll pay.
column9: To pay the bill: 我來買單, 請買單. It is said in a restaurant, and also means "I'm treating". Figuratively 不買單 is "not buying it". 買 shows a net 罒 over a shell 貝 (money); 賣 "sell" has the same two parts, with 出 "go out" on top.

column3: Box-office success: 卖座电影, 很卖座, 卖座大片. It is a film, show or restaurant that fills its seats. 卖 "sell" + 座 "seat". 座 has 广 "building" and 坐 "sit", which also gives the sound (zuò).
column6: Zhè bù diànyǐng fēicháng màizuò.
column7: This film is a big box-office hit.
column9: Box-office success: 賣座電影, 很賣座, 賣座大片. It is a film, show or restaurant that fills its seats. 賣 "sell" + 座 "seat". 座 has 广 "building" and 坐 "sit", which also gives the sound (zuò).

column3: Busy, bustling: 忙碌的一天, 忙碌的生活, 整天忙碌. It describes a stretch of time filled with work. 忙 has 忄 "heart" and 亡 for the sound (máng, the same), and 碌 has 石 and 录 (lù); 碌 is hardly used apart from this word.
column6: Tā měi tiān dōu guò de hěn mánglù.
column7: She is busy every day.
column9: Busy, bustling: 忙碌的一天, 忙碌的生活, 整天忙碌. It describes a stretch of time filled with work. 忙 has 忄 "heart" and 亡 for the sound (máng, the same), and 碌 has 石 and 彔 (lù); 碌 is hardly used apart from this word.

column3: Blind, of actions taken without thought or information: 盲目跟风 "blindly follow the trend", 盲目崇拜, 盲目乐观. 盲 shows an eye 目 that has lost 亡 its sight, and 亡 gives the sound (máng, wáng). The word is used for people who act blindly, not for literally blind people (that is 盲人).
column6: Bùyào mángmù gēn fēng.
column7: Don't follow the trend blindly.
column9: Blind, of actions taken without thought or information: 盲目跟風 "blindly follow the trend", 盲目崇拜, 盲目樂觀. 盲 shows an eye 目 that has lost 亡 its sight, and 亡 gives the sound (máng, wáng). The word is used for people who act blindly, not for literally blind people (that is 盲人).

column3: Sparrow, the small brown bird that lives in towns and parks: 一只麻雀, 麻雀在树上叫. 雀 is 小 "small" over 隹 "bird", so a small bird. Mahjong, the game, is 麻将 (麻雀 in Cantonese).
column6: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō máquè.
column7: There are many sparrows in the park.
column9: Sparrow, the small brown bird that lives in towns and parks: 一隻麻雀, 麻雀在樹上叫. 雀 is 小 "small" over 隹 "bird", so a small bird. Mahjong, the game, is 麻將 (麻雀 in Cantonese).

column3: Pleasing to the eye, beautiful, said of how something looks or is arranged: 外观美观, 房间布置得很美观. It describes things people made, a room, a building, a page, more than natural scenery. 美 "beautiful" + 观 "view". It often comes with 大方 or 实用.
column6: Zhège pánzi hěn měiguān.
column7: This plate looks very nice.
column9: Pleasing to the eye, beautiful, said of how something looks or is arranged: 外觀美觀, 房間佈置得很美觀. It describes things people made, a room, a building, a page, more than natural scenery. 美 "beautiful" + 觀 "view". It often comes with 大方 or 實用.

column3: Plum blossom, the flower of the 梅 tree, which blooms in winter and stands for courage in the cold. 梅花 is also Taiwan's national flower. 梅 has 木 "tree" for the meaning and 每 for the sound (méi, the same). In card games it is also the suit of clubs.
column6: Yángmíngshān shàng de méihuā kāi le.
column7: The plum blossoms on Yangmingshan are out.
column9: Plum blossom, the flower of the 梅 tree, which blooms in winter and stands for courage in the cold. 梅花 is also Taiwan's national flower. 梅 has 木 "tree" for the meaning and 每 for the sound (méi, the same). In card games it is also the suit of clubs.

column3: Charm, appeal: 有魅力 "to have charm", 个人魅力 "personal charm". It can be a person's or a place's: 这个城市很有魅力. 魅 has 鬼 "ghost" for the meaning and 未 for the sound (wèi, close to mèi); it first meant a spirit, and the charm of a person is the pull that seems to come from outside. 力 "force" is the second syllable.
column6: Tā hěn yǒu mèilì.
column7: He has a lot of charm.
column9: Charm, appeal: 有魅力 "to have charm", 個人魅力 "personal charm". It can be a person's or a place's: 這個城市很有魅力. 魅 has 鬼 "ghost" for the meaning and 未 for the sound (wèi, close to mèi); it first meant a spirit, and the charm of a person is the pull that seems to come from outside. 力 "force" is the second syllable.

column3: Wonderful, lovely, for something that is a delight to hear or feel: 美妙的音乐, 美妙的夜晚. It is a bit literary, used in praise of music, voices, feelings or moments. 美 "beautiful" + 妙 "subtle, marvelous"; 妙 has 女 and 少 and is read miào.
column6: Tā de gēshēng hěn měimiào.
column7: Her singing voice is lovely.
column9: Wonderful, lovely, for something that is a delight to hear or feel: 美妙的音樂, 美妙的夜晚. It is a bit literary, used in praise of music, voices, feelings or moments. 美 "beautiful" + 妙 "subtle, marvelous"; 妙 has 女 and 少 and is read miào.

column3: Beauty salon, a place for hair, skin and nails: 去美容院做脸 "go to a beauty salon for a facial". 美容 "beautify the looks" + 院, a place or institution. 美发 is for hair only, and 美容院 covers facials and body care. The "salon" for hair is also called 美发院.
column6: Tā měi ge yuè qù měiróngyuàn.
column7: She goes to the beauty salon every month.
column9: Beauty salon, a place for hair, skin and nails: 去美容院做臉 "go to a beauty salon for a facial". 美容 "beautify the looks" + 院, a place or institution. 美髮 is for hair only, and 美容院 covers facials and body care. The "salon" for hair is also called 美髮院.

column3: Fierce, violent for force: 猛烈, 火很猛, 风很猛. As an adverb it means "suddenly, abruptly": 他猛地站起来. In speech 猛 can also be slang praise, "awesome": 你好猛！ 猛 has 犭 "dog, animal" for the meaning and 孟 for the sound; a fierce animal is the picture.
column6: Tā měng de zhàn le qǐlái.
column7: He suddenly stood up.
column9: Fierce, violent for force: 猛烈, 火很猛, 風很猛. As an adverb it means "suddenly, abruptly": 他猛地站起來. In speech 猛 can also be slang praise, "awesome": 你好猛！ 猛 has 犭 "dog, animal" for the meaning and 孟 for the sound; a fierce animal is the picture.

column3: To dream of: 昨晚我梦到你了. 梦 is "dream" and 到 "arrive, reach", so the dream reaches a person or thing. The person or thing dreamed of comes right after: 梦到老朋友. 梦见 means almost the same; 梦到 is the more spoken form.
column4: 我昨天梦到了小时候的家。
column5: 我昨天夢到了小時候的家。
column6: Wǒ zuótiān mèngdào le xiǎoshíhou de jiā.
column7: Yesterday I dreamed of the home I had as a child.
column9: To dream of: 昨晚我夢到你了. 夢 is "dream" and 到 "arrive, reach", so the dream reaches a person or thing. The person or thing dreamed of comes right after: 夢到老朋友. 夢見 means almost the same; 夢到 is the more spoken form.

column3: Sultry, hot and stuffy: 天气闷热, 闷热的夏天. It is for heat with no breeze and heavy humidity, as in summer before a storm. 闷 is "stuffy, depressed" and 热 "hot". Here 闷 is read mēn, while in 烦闷 it is mèn.
column6: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn mēnrè.
column7: The weather is sultry today.
column9: Sultry, hot and stuffy: 天氣悶熱, 悶熱的夏天. It is for heat with no breeze and heavy humidity, as in summer before a storm. 悶 is "stuffy, depressed" and 熱 "hot". Here 悶 is read mēn, while in 煩悶 it is mèn.

column3: Cotton, the plant and the material: 棉布 "cotton cloth", 纯棉 "pure cotton", 棉质. It is usually part of a compound. The character is a variant of 绵 "silk floss" with 木 "tree" in place of 糸 "silk", because cotton grows on a plant.
column6: Zhè jiàn chènshān shì chúnmián de.
column7: This shirt is pure cotton.
column9: Cotton, the plant and the material: 棉布 "cotton cloth", 純棉 "pure cotton", 棉質. It is usually part of a compound. The character is a variant of 綿 "silk floss" with 木 "tree" in place of 糸 "silk", because cotton grows on a plant.

column3: Quilt, comforter, the padded bedcover: 盖棉被 "sleep under a quilt", 一条棉被. It is 棉 "cotton" + 被 "quilt", the padding being cotton. 被子 is the general word for a bedcover; 棉被 says it is filled with cotton.
column6: Tiānqì lěng le, yào gài miánbèi.
column7: It has turned cold, so we need a quilt.
column9: Quilt, comforter, the padded bedcover: 蓋棉被 "sleep under a quilt", 一條棉被. It is 棉 "cotton" + 被 "quilt", the padding being cotton. 被子 is the general word for a bedcover; 棉被 says it is filled with cotton.

column3: So as not to, lest: it begins the second part of a sentence and names a bad result that the first part is meant to prevent: 带把伞，免得淋湿. 免 "avoid" + 得 "get". The result is always unwanted, so 免得 is not used for good outcomes. The 得 is neutral.
column6: Dài bǎ sǎn ba, miǎnde línshī.
column7: Take an umbrella so you don't get wet.
column9: So as not to, lest: it begins the second part of a sentence and names a bad result that the first part is meant to prevent: 帶把傘，免得淋濕. 免 "avoid" + 得 "get". The result is always unwanted, so 免得 is not used for good outcomes. The 得 is neutral.

column3: Flour, the wheat flour for noodles, dumplings and bread: 一包面粉. 面 is "noodles, wheat flour" and 粉 "powder". It is 面粉 even for bread and cake; 米粉 is a different thing, rice flour or rice noodles.
column6: Zuò miànbāo yào yòng miànfěn.
column7: You need flour to make bread.
column9: Flour, the wheat flour for noodles, dumplings and bread: 一包麵粉. 麵 is "noodles, wheat flour" and 粉 "powder". It is 麵粉 even for bread and cake; 米粉 is a different thing, rice flour or rice noodles. 麵 has 麥 "wheat" on its left.

column3: Cotton the fiber, the wad of it: 棉花糖 "cotton candy", 一团棉花. It is 棉 "cotton" + 花 "flower", the white boll opening like a flower. The 花 is neutral. Also found: 棉花棒 "cotton swab".
column6: Yīshēng yòng miánhua cā shāngkǒu.
column7: The doctor wipes the wound with cotton.
column9: Cotton the fiber, the wad of it: 棉花糖 "cotton candy", 一團棉花. It is 棉 "cotton" + 花 "flower", the white boll opening like a flower. The 花 is neutral. Also found: 棉花棒 "cotton swab".

column3: Barely, reluctantly, or "to force someone": 勉强可以 "just about all right", 勉强笑了笑 "force a smile", 不要勉强他 "don't force him". As an adjective it says something is only just enough or done against one's will. 勉 means "make an effort" (力 "strength" is its meaning part, 免 the sound) and 强 "strong", so effort with strain.
column6: Zhège bànfǎ miǎnqiǎng kěyǐ.
column7: This method will just about do.
column9: Barely, reluctantly, or "to force someone": 勉強可以 "just about all right", 勉強笑了笑 "force a smile", 不要勉強他 "don't force him". As an adjective it says something is only just enough or done against one's will. 勉 means "make an effort" (力 "strength" is its meaning part, 免 the sound) and 強 "strong", so effort with strain.

column3: Face-to-face talk, an interview, for a job or admission: 面谈时间, 通过面谈. It is 面 "face" + 谈 "talk". It is a formal word for an interview, with 面试 more common for a job interview and 面谈 also for a talk with a teacher or a counselor.
column6: Lǎoshī xiǎng hé jiāzhǎng miàntán.
column7: The teacher wants to talk to the parents face to face.
column9: Face-to-face talk, an interview, for a job or admission: 面談時間, 通過面談. It is 面 "face" + 談 "talk". It is a formal word for an interview, with 面試 more common for a job interview and 面談 also for a talk with a teacher or a counselor.

column3: Wonderful, clever, and in speech as an exclamation: 妙！ or 这个主意很妙. It has a trace of surprise: the idea is neat and unexpected. Common in 美妙, 巧妙 and 奇妙. 妙 has 女 and 少; the sound is that of 少 (shào or shǎo), changed to miào.
column6: Zhège zhǔyi zhēn miào!
column7: What a clever idea!
column9: Wonderful, clever, and in speech as an exclamation: 妙！ or 這個主意很妙. It has a trace of surprise: the idea is neat and unexpected. Common in 美妙, 巧妙 and 奇妙. 妙 has 女 and 少; the sound is that of 少 (shào or shǎo), changed to miào.

column3: To be destroyed, to become extinct, and with an object "to destroy": 恐龙灭亡了 "the dinosaurs died out", 国家灭亡. It suits peoples, states and species, not a single person or a fire. 灭 "wipe out" + 亡 "perish". The meaning is large and final.
column6: Kǒnglóng wèishénme huì mièwáng?
column7: Why did the dinosaurs die out?
column9: To be destroyed, to become extinct, and with an object "to destroy": 恐龍滅亡了 "the dinosaurs died out", 國家滅亡. It suits peoples, states and species, not a single person or a fire. 滅 "wipe out" + 亡 "perish". The meaning is large and final.

column3: Honeybee, the bee that makes honey: 一只蜜蜂, 蜜蜂采蜜. 蜜 "honey" and 蜂 "bee", each with 虫 "insect" in it, the part for insects and bugs. 蜜蜂 is the insect; the honey is 蜂蜜.
column6: Mìfēng zài huā shàng cǎi mì.
column7: The bee collects honey from the flowers.
column9: Honeybee, the bee that makes honey: 一隻蜜蜂, 蜜蜂採蜜. 蜜 "honey" and 蜂 "bee", each with 虫 "insect" in it, the part for insects and bugs. 蜜蜂 is the insect; the honey is 蜂蜜.

column3: Bee, wasp, mostly in compounds: 蜜蜂, 蜂蜜 "honey", 蜂巢 "hive, honeycomb", 黄蜂 "wasp". It is also a verb part in 蜂拥 "swarm like bees". 虫 "insect" is the meaning part, and 夆 supplies the sound (fēng, nearly the same).
column6: Fēngcháo lǐ yǒu hěn duō mìfēng.
column7: There are many bees in the hive.
column9: Bee, wasp, mostly in compounds: 蜜蜂, 蜂蜜 "honey", 蜂巢 "hive, honeycomb", 黃蜂 "wasp". It is also a verb part in 蜂擁 "swarm like bees". 虫 "insect" is the meaning part, and 夆 supplies the sound (fēng, nearly the same).

column3: Muddled, dazed: 迷糊 describes a half-conscious or confused state, such as after waking: 我还迷糊着. It is also someone who is forgetful and scatterbrained, "absent-minded": 她很迷糊. Both characters mean "confused" and the second is neutral.
column6: Wǒ gāng shuìxǐng, nǎozi hái míhu.
column7: I just woke up and my head is still foggy.
column9: Muddled, dazed: 迷糊 describes a half-conscious or confused state, such as after waking: 我還迷糊著. It is also someone who is forgetful and scatterbrained, "absent-minded": 她很迷糊. Both characters mean "confused" and the second is neutral.

column3: Famous brand: 名牌包 "a designer bag", 穿名牌 "wear designer clothes". 名 "name, fame" + 牌 "sign, brand". It also means a plaque or name tag, but the brand is the common sense. Something labeled 名牌 is expensive and known.
column6: Tā xǐhuān mǎi míngpái bāo.
column7: She likes to buy designer bags.
column9: Famous brand: 名牌包 "a designer bag", 穿名牌 "wear designer clothes". 名 "name, fame" + 牌 "sign, brand". It also means a plaque or name tag, but the brand is the common sense. Something labeled 名牌 is expensive and known.

column3: Folk song, ballad: 民谣 "folk song" + 民 "people" + 谣 "song, rumor". In Taiwan it covers both the traditional songs, such as 恒春民谣, and the acoustic folk music of the 1970s on, which was called 民歌. 谣 has 讠 "speech" on its left.
column4: 他会弹吉他，也会唱民谣。
column5: 他會彈吉他，也會唱民謠。
column6: Tā huì tán jítā, yě huì chàng mínyáo.
column7: He can play the guitar and also sing folk songs.
column9: Folk song, ballad: 民謠 "folk song" + 民 "people" + 謠 "song, rumor". In Taiwan it covers both the traditional songs, such as 恆春民謠, and the acoustic folk music of the 1970s on, which was called 民歌. 謠 has 言 "speech" on its left.

column3: The public, the people, in news and speeches: 民众的意见, 一般民众. 民 "people" + 众 "crowd". It speaks of ordinary people against the government or the police: 民众服务, 保护民众. 众 shows three 人 "people" pressed together.
column6: Zhèngfǔ yào bǎohù mínzhòng.
column7: The government must protect the public.
column9: The public, the people, in news and speeches: 民眾的意見, 一般民眾. 民 "people" + 眾 "crowd". It speaks of ordinary people against the government or the police: 民眾服務, 保護民眾. 眾 shows three 人 "people" pressed together.

column3: Democracy and "democratic": 民主国家, 民主制度, 民主选举. It is 民 "people" + 主 "master", the people as master. 民主 also describes a manner of leading, as in 他的作风很民主.
column4: 台湾是一个民主的地方。
column5: 臺灣是一個民主的地方。
column6: Táiwān shì yī ge mínzhǔ de dìfang.
column7: Taiwan is a democratic place.
column9: Democracy and "democratic": 民主國家, 民主制度, 民主選舉. It is 民 "people" + 主 "master", the people as master. 民主 also describes a manner of leading, as in 他的作風很民主.

column3: To lose one's way, to lose one's bearings: 在森林里迷失方向, 迷失自我 "lose oneself". 迷 "be lost" + 失 "lose". It can be about a place or about one's direction in life. 迷 has 辶 "walk" at its base, since being lost is a matter of the road.
column4: 我们在山里迷失了方向。
column5: 我們在山裡迷失了方向。
column6: Wǒmen zài shān lǐ míshī le fāngxiàng.
column7: We lost our way in the mountains.
column9: To lose one's way, to lose one's bearings: 在森林裡迷失方向, 迷失自我 "lose oneself". 迷 "be lost" + 失 "lose". It can be about a place or about one's direction in life. 迷 has 辶 "walk" at its base, since being lost is a matter of the road.

column3: To smear, to wipe: 抹药 "apply ointment", 抹桌子 "wipe the table", 抹防晒乳. You spread something over a surface with your hand or a cloth. It also counts wisps of light or cloud: 一抹微笑 "a trace of a smile". 扌 "hand" is the meaning part.
column6: Chūmén qián yào mǒ fángshàirǔ.
column7: Put on sunscreen before you go out.
column9: To smear, to wipe: 抹藥 "apply ointment", 抹桌子 "wipe the table", 抹防曬乳. You spread something over a surface with your hand or a cloth. It also counts wisps of light or cloud: 一抹微笑 "a trace of a smile". 扌 "hand" is the meaning part.

column3: To rub, to grind, to wear down: 磨刀 "sharpen a knife", 磨豆浆 "grind soybeans", 磨牙 "grind one's teeth". It also means to wear down or to dawdle, as in 磨蹭 "dawdle". 石 "stone" is at the bottom, because grinding was done with a stone.
column6: Tā měitiān mó kāfēi dòu.
column7: He grinds coffee beans every day.
column9: To rub, to grind, to wear down: 磨刀 "sharpen a knife", 磨豆漿 "grind soybeans", 磨牙 "grind one's teeth". It also means to wear down or to dawdle, as in 磨蹭 "dawdle". 石 "stone" is at the bottom, because grinding was done with a stone.

column3: Destination, the place one is going to: 目的地是台南 "the destination is Tainan", 到达目的地. 目的 "purpose" + 地 "place". The 地 comes twice in the pinyin, since 的 is read di here, and 地 di as well.
column6: Wǒmen kuài dào mùdìdì le.
column7: We are almost at our destination.
column9: Destination, the place one is going to: 目的地是台南 "the destination is Tainan", 到達目的地. 目的 "purpose" + 地 "place". The 地 comes twice in the pinyin, since 的 is read di here, and 地 di as well.

column3: Table of contents, catalog, directory: 书的目录 "a book's contents", 目录 on a computer is also a folder, though for a folder Taiwan more often says 资料夹 and the mainland 文件夹. 目 "item, eye" + 录 "record". 录 has 金 "metal" for engraving, hence "record".
column6: Qǐng xiān kàn mùlù, zài zhǎo yèshù.
column7: Look at the table of contents first, then find the page.
column9: Table of contents, catalog, directory: 書的目錄 "a book's contents", 目錄 on a computer is also a folder, though for a folder Taiwan more often says 資料夾 and the mainland 文件夾. 目 "item, eye" + 錄 "record". 錄 has 金 "metal" for engraving, hence "record".

column3: Milk powder: 奶粉 for babies and for adults who make milk drinks: 冲奶粉 "make up milk from powder". 奶 "milk" + 粉 "powder". It is a common baby product, and 婴儿奶粉 is "infant formula". 冲 is the verb that goes with it.
column6: Bǎobao hē nǎifěn.
column7: The baby drinks formula.
column9: Milk powder: 奶粉 for babies and for adults who make milk drinks: 沖奶粉 "make up milk from powder". 奶 "milk" + 粉 "powder". It is a common baby product, and 嬰兒奶粉 is "infant formula". 沖 is the verb that goes with it.

column3: Durable, hard-wearing: 这双鞋很耐用. 耐 "withstand" + 用 "use". It is for things, not for people, with the idea that they last many years of use. 耐 appears in other words, 耐心 "patience", 耐烦, 耐吃. 耐 has 而 and a 寸 "hand-measure".
column6: Zhège guō yòu piányí yòu nàiyòng.
column7: This pot is both cheap and durable.
column9: Durable, hard-wearing: 這雙鞋很耐用. 耐 "withstand" + 用 "use". It is for things, not for people, with the idea that they last many years of use. 耐 appears in other words, 耐心 "patience", 耐煩, 耐吃. 耐 has 而 and a 寸 "hand-measure".

column3: Brains, mind, the way one thinks: 动脑筋 "use one's head", 伤脑筋 "to be a headache", 他脑筋很好. It is spoken and speaks of the mind as the tool for solving problems. 脑 "brain" + 筋 "sinew, nerve".
column4: 这个问题要动一下脑筋。
column5: 這個問題要動一下腦筋。
column6: Zhège wèntí yào dòng yīxià nǎojīn.
column7: This problem takes some thinking.
column9: Brains, mind, the way one thinks: 動腦筋 "use one's head", 傷腦筋 "to be a headache", 他腦筋很好. It is spoken and speaks of the mind as the tool for solving problems. 腦 "brain" + 筋 "sinew, nerve".

column3: Busy commercial district, downtown: 逛闹区 "stroll the shopping area", 台北东区的闹区. This is mostly a Taiwan word; the mainland more often says 闹市. 闹 "noisy, lively" + 区 "district". It names an area full of shops, crowds and lights, as 西门町 is.
column6: Zhōumò de nàoqū rén hěn duō.
column7: The downtown area is crowded on weekends.
column9: Busy commercial district, downtown: 逛鬧區 "stroll the shopping area", 台北東區的鬧區. This is mostly a Taiwan word; the mainland more often says 鬧市. 鬧 "noisy, lively" + 區 "district". It names an area full of shops, crowds and lights, as 西門町 is.

column3: Inland, the interior of a country, away from the coast: 内地的气候, 内地和沿海 "inland and coastal areas". 内 "inside" + 地 "land". It is a place word, not a person word.
column4: 内地的天气比海边干燥。
column5: 內地的天氣比海邊乾燥。
column6: Nèidì de tiānqì bǐ hǎibiān gānzào.
column7: The weather inland is drier than by the sea.
column9: Inland, the interior of a country, away from the coast: 內地的氣候, 內地和沿海 "inland and coastal areas". 內 "inside" + 地 "land". It is a place word, not a person word.

column3: Expert, adept, someone who knows a field well: 他是内行 "he is an expert", 内行人 "an insider", 外行 is its opposite, "layman". 内 "inside" + 行 "trade, line of work", so someone inside the trade. The 行 is read háng, not xíng.
column6: Tā duì diànnǎo hěn nèiháng.
column7: He is an expert on computers.
column9: Expert, adept, someone who knows a field well: 他是內行 "he is an expert", 內行人 "an insider", 外行 is its opposite, "layman". 內 "inside" + 行 "trade, line of work", so someone inside the trade. The 行 is read háng, not xíng.

column3: Energy source, energy as a resource: 再生能源 "renewable energy", 能源危机 "energy crisis", 节省能源. It is the word of news, policy and school texts, for oil, coal, solar and so on. 能 "ability, capacity to do work" + 源 "source". 源 has 氵 "water" in it, as a spring is where a river starts.
column6: Wǒmen yīnggāi jiéshěng néngyuán.
column7: We should save energy.
column9: Energy source, energy as a resource: 再生能源 "renewable energy", 能源危機 "energy crisis", 節省能源. It is the word of news, policy and school texts, for oil, coal, solar and so on. 能 "ability, capacity to do work" + 源 "source". 源 has 氵 "water" in it, as a spring is where a river starts.

column3: Mud, clay: 泥巴 "mud", 泥土 "soil", 烂泥 "sludge", 水泥 "cement". On its own it is mud on shoes or hands: 鞋子上都是泥. 氵 "water" is the meaning part, since mud is soil with water, and 尼 gives the sound (ní, the same).
column6: Tā de xiézi shàng dōu shì ní.
column7: His shoes are covered in mud.
column9: Mud, clay: 泥巴 "mud", 泥土 "soil", 爛泥 "sludge", 水泥 "cement". On its own it is mud on shoes or hands: 鞋子上都是泥. 氵 "water" is the meaning part, since mud is soil with water, and 尼 gives the sound (ní, the same).

column3: Greasy, rich, for food that is too oily or sweet: 太油腻了 "too greasy". It also means "tired of" something from having too much: 吃腻了 "sick of eating it", 看腻了. 腻 has 月 as flesh on its left, as it began with fatty meat, and 贰 for the sound.
column6: Zhè dào cài tài yóunì le.
column7: This dish is too greasy.
column9: Greasy, rich, for food that is too oily or sweet: 太油膩了 "too greasy". It also means "tired of" something from having too much: 吃膩了 "sick of eating it", 看膩了. 膩 has 月 as flesh on its left, as it began with fatty meat, and 貳 for the sound.

column3: Sticky, and in Taiwan the verb "to stick, to glue": 黏黏的 "sticky", 黏在一起, 黏贴 "paste". It is also in 黏土 "clay" and 黏胶. The mainland writes the verb 粘, read zhān. 黍 "millet" is the meaning part, since sticky grain was the thing that clung, and 占 gives the sound.
column6: Tángguǒ nián zài yáchǐ shàng le.
column7: The candy stuck to my teeth.
column9: Sticky, and in Taiwan the verb "to stick, to glue": 黏黏的 "sticky", 黏在一起, 黏貼 "paste". It is also in 黏土 "clay" and 黏膠. The mainland writes the verb 粘, read zhān. 黍 "millet" is the meaning part, since sticky grain was the thing that clung, and 占 gives the sound.

column3: Sticky, and in Taiwan "to stick, to glue", the same word as 黏, written with 米 "rice" in place of 黍 "millet": sticky rice is what the character began as. Taiwan reads it nián here: 粘贴 "paste", 粘在墙上. In 黏 and 粘 the right side 占 gives the sound.
column6: Qǐng bǎ zhàopiàn nián zài zhèlǐ.
column7: Please stick the photo here.
column9: Sticky, and in Taiwan "to stick, to glue", the same word as 黏, written with 米 "rice" in place of 黍 "millet": sticky rice is what the character began as. Taiwan reads it nián here: 粘貼 "paste", 粘在牆上. In 黏 and 粘 the right side 占 gives the sound.

column3: To urinate and "urine": 尿尿 in baby talk, 尿床 "wet the bed", 尿布 "diaper", 尿液 in a medical test. It is plain, and in polite speech people say 上厕所. The character is 尸 "a person" over 水 "water", which is just what it says.
column6: Bǎobao niào chuáng le.
column7: The baby wet the bed.
column9: To urinate and "urine": 尿尿 in baby talk, 尿床 "wet the bed", 尿布 "diaper", 尿液 in a medical test. It is plain, and in polite speech people say 上廁所. The character is 尸 "a person" over 水 "water", which is just what it says.

column3: To pinch, to hold between thumb and fingers: 捏鼻子 "hold one's nose", 捏面团 "knead dough", 捏一把冷汗 "break into a cold sweat", where one is anxious for someone. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part. Doing it with the fingers is the point.
column6: Tā niē zhe bízi zǒu guòqù.
column7: He walked past holding his nose.
column9: To pinch, to hold between thumb and fingers: 捏鼻子 "hold one's nose", 捏麵團 "knead dough", 捏一把冷汗 "break into a cold sweat", where one is anxious for someone. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part. Doing it with the fingers is the point.

column3: Would rather, preferably: 宁可 A 也不 B, "rather A than B": 我宁可走路也不坐车. It gives your choice between two things you dislike. 宁 is "peaceful" and 可 "may"; the two together are about preferring. Often with 也不 or 也要. It is a written-flavored word; 宁愿 means the same.
column4: 我宁可走路，也不想挤公车。
column5: 我寧可走路，也不想擠公車。
column6: Wǒ nìngkě zǒulù, yě bù xiǎng jǐ gōngchē.
column7: I would rather walk than squeeze onto a bus.
column9: Would rather, preferably: 寧可 A 也不 B, "rather A than B": 我寧可走路也不坐車. It gives your choice between two things you dislike. 寧 is "peaceful" and 可 "may"; the two together are about preferring. Often with 也不 or 也要. It is a written-flavored word; 寧願 means the same.

column3: Would rather ... (than ...): 宁愿 A 也不 B, as in 我宁愿待在家里，也不想出去. 愿 is "be willing", so 宁愿 stresses that you are willing to accept the first thing. It is close to 宁可, and the two can usually be swapped.
column4: 我宁愿早点出门，也不想迟到。
column5: 我寧願早點出門，也不想遲到。
column6: Wǒ nìngyuàn zǎodiǎn chūmén, yě bù xiǎng chídào.
column7: I would rather leave early than be late.
column9: Would rather ... (than ...): 寧願 A 也不 B, as in 我寧願待在家裡，也不想出去. 願 is "be willing", so 寧願 stresses that you are willing to accept the first thing. It is close to 寧可, and the two can usually be swapped.

column3: Soil, earth, the stuff you dig or walk on: 泥土的味道 "the smell of earth", 一堆泥土. 泥 "mud" + 土 "earth". It is more about the material than about a field or a place, and it carries a sense of the countryside, of the earth.
column4: 雨后泥土的味道很好闻。
column5: 雨後泥土的味道很好聞。
column6: Yǔ hòu nítǔ de wèidào hěn hǎo wén.
column7: The smell of the earth after rain is lovely.
column9: Soil, earth, the stuff you dig or walk on: 泥土的味道 "the smell of earth", 一堆泥土. 泥 "mud" + 土 "earth". It is more about the material than about a field or a place, and it carries a sense of the countryside, of the earth.

column3: Farm: 农场 is a piece of land with crops or animals: 牧场 "ranch", 养鸡场 "poultry farm". 农 "agriculture" + 场 "a place for activities". A 休闲农场 is a farm open to visitors to pick fruit and stay.
column4: 我们周末去农场摘草莓。
column5: 我們週末去農場摘草莓。
column6: Wǒmen zhōumò qù nóngchǎng zhāi cǎoméi.
column7: At the weekend we go to a farm to pick strawberries.
column9: Farm: 農場 is a piece of land with crops or animals: 牧場 "ranch", 養雞場 "poultry farm". 農 "agriculture" + 場 "a place for activities". A 休閒農場 is a farm open to visitors to pick fruit and stay.

column3: To get something wrong, to mix up: 弄 "do, handle" + 错 "wrong". It follows what was mixed: 弄错日期 "get the date wrong", 弄错人 "mistake someone for another". It is a mistake of fact or identity, and the speaker often says "sorry, I made a mistake" with 我弄错了.
column6: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ nòngcuò shíjiān le.
column7: Sorry, I got the time wrong.
column9: To get something wrong, to mix up: 弄 "do, handle" + 錯 "wrong". It follows what was mixed: 弄錯日期 "get the date wrong", 弄錯人 "mistake someone for another". It is a mistake of fact or identity, and the speaker often says "sorry, I made a mistake" with 我弄錯了.

column3: Thick, strong, dense, for feelings, atmosphere or interest in an abstract way: 兴趣浓厚 "a strong interest", 浓厚的乡土味 "a strong local flavor". 浓 is "thick, strong" (tea, color, fog) and 厚 "thick". It goes with abstract nouns, not with a cup of coffee, where 浓 alone is used.
column4: 他对历史有浓厚的兴趣。
column5: 他對歷史有濃厚的興趣。
column6: Tā duì lìshǐ yǒu nónghòu de xìngqù.
column7: He has a strong interest in history.
column9: Thick, strong, dense, for feelings, atmosphere or interest in an abstract way: 興趣濃厚 "a strong interest", 濃厚的鄉土味 "a strong local flavor". 濃 is "thick, strong" (tea, color, fog) and 厚 "thick". It goes with abstract nouns, not with a cup of coffee, where 濃 alone is used.

column3: Farmer, a man who works the land: 一位农夫. 农 "farming" + 夫 "man, worker". It sounds a little like a story: 农夫与蛇 "The Farmer and the Snake". For a person's job today, 农民 is the more usual word.
column4: 农夫早上很早就下田了。
column5: 農夫早上很早就下田了。
column6: Nóngfū zǎoshang hěn zǎo jiù xià tián le.
column7: The farmer goes down to the fields very early in the morning.
column9: Farmer, a man who works the land: 一位農夫. 農 "farming" + 夫 "man, worker". It sounds a little like a story: 農夫與蛇 "The Farmer and the Snake". For a person's job today, 農民 is the more usual word.

column3: Pesticide: 喷农药 "spray pesticide", 农药残留 "pesticide residue", a common worry about vegetables and fruit. 农 "farming" + 药 "medicine", so medicine for crops. Grocery shoppers talk of 有机 "organic" produce as having no 农药.
column6: Zhèxiē shūcài méiyǒu nóngyào.
column7: These vegetables have no pesticide.
column9: Pesticide: 噴農藥 "spray pesticide", 農藥殘留 "pesticide residue", a common worry about vegetables and fruit. 農 "farming" + 藥 "medicine", so medicine for crops. Grocery shoppers talk of 有機 "organic" produce as having no 農藥.

column3: Occasionally, once in a while: 偶而吃一次 "eat it now and then". 偶 means "by chance" and 而 is a particle, so a thing that happens by chance. The same meaning is written 偶尔, and the pronunciation in the dictionary is ǒu'ér for both; 偶尔 is the standard form. It goes before the verb.
column6: Wǒ ǒu'ér huì qù páshān.
column7: I occasionally go hiking.
column9: Occasionally, once in a while: 偶而吃一次 "eat it now and then". 偶 means "by chance" and 而 is a particle, so a thing that happens by chance. The same meaning is written 偶爾, and the pronunciation in the dictionary is ǒu'ér for both; 偶爾 is the standard form. It goes before the verb.

column3: To reject, to exclude, to repel: 排斥外人 "shut outsiders out", 排斥反应 "rejection" of a transplant, and 排斥新事物 "resist what is new". It is something done by a group or by the body to what does not belong. 排 "push aside" + 斥 "reject". The feeling is stronger than 不喜欢.
column6: Tāmen páichì xīn lái de tóngxué.
column7: They shut out the new classmate.
column9: To reject, to exclude, to repel: 排斥外人 "shut outsiders out", 排斥反應 "rejection" of a transplant, and 排斥新事物 "resist what is new". It is something done by a group or by the body to what does not belong. 排 "push aside" + 斥 "reject". The feeling is stronger than 不喜歡.

column3: To climb by pulling oneself up: 攀岩 "rock climbing", 攀登 "climb", 攀爬. And "to claim connections with someone above": 攀关系. 手 "hand" is at the bottom, and 樊 above gives the sound (fán, close to pān). The climbing is done with the hands, on a cliff or a rope.
column6: Tāmen yīqǐ qù pānyán.
column7: They go rock climbing together.
column9: To climb by pulling oneself up: 攀岩 "rock climbing", 攀登 "climb", 攀爬. And "to claim connections with someone above": 攀關係. 手 "hand" is at the bottom, and 樊 above gives the sound (fán, close to pān). The climbing is done with the hands, on a cliff or a rope.

column3: Cannon, firework: 大炮 "cannon", 鞭炮 "firecrackers", 放炮 "set off fireworks". 鞭炮 are set off at weddings, temple events and the New Year. 炮 has 火 "fire" and 包 for the sound (the old sound was close to pào).
column6: Xīnnián shí dàjiā huì fàng biānpào.
column7: At New Year people set off firecrackers.
column9: Cannon, firework: 大炮 "cannon", 鞭炮 "firecrackers", 放炮 "set off fireworks". 鞭炮 are set off at weddings, temple events and the New Year. 炮 has 火 "fire" and 包 for the sound (the old sound was close to pào).

column3: To admire, for a person's skill or character: 我很佩服你 "I really admire you", 令人佩服. It is said to someone's face or about them, and means respect for what they can do. 佩 once meant a sash worn at the waist; 服 here is "to be convinced".
column6: Wǒ hěn pèifú tā de yǒngqì.
column7: I really admire his courage.
column9: To admire, for a person's skill or character: 我很佩服你 "I really admire you", 令人佩服. It is said to someone's face or about them, and means respect for what they can do. 佩 once meant a sash worn at the waist; 服 here is "to be convinced".

column3: To accompany, a formal word for going along with a guest or an official: 由老师陪同 "accompanied by the teacher", 陪同参观. 陪 "keep company" + 同 "together". In speech 陪 alone or 陪着 is used.
column4: 家长陪同孩子一起参加。
column5: 家長陪同孩子一起參加。
column6: Jiāzhǎng péitóng háizi yīqǐ cānjiā.
column7: Parents take part together with their children.
column9: To accompany, a formal word for going along with a guest or an official: 由老師陪同 "accompanied by the teacher", 陪同參觀. 陪 "keep company" + 同 "together". In speech 陪 alone or 陪著 is used.

column3: To hold in both hands, cupped, and "to praise": 捧着一杯茶 "holding a cup of tea in both hands", 捧场 "support an event by coming". 扌 "hand" and 奉, "offer with both hands"; the sound is that of 奉 (fèng, close to pěng). A classifier for what both hands can hold: 一捧米.
column6: Tā shǒu lǐ pěng zhe yī wǎn rè tāng.
column7: She holds a bowl of hot soup in both hands.
column9: To hold in both hands, cupped, and "to praise": 捧著一杯茶 "holding a cup of tea in both hands", 捧場 "support an event by coming". 扌 "hand" and 奉, "offer with both hands"; the sound is that of 奉 (fèng, close to pěng). A classifier for what both hands can hold: 一捧米.

column3: To expand, to swell: 通货膨胀 "inflation", 膨胀的气球 "a swelling balloon", and for pride: 自信心膨胀. Both characters have 月 "flesh" on the left, which fits swelling. 膨's sound part 彭 is read péng, the same.
column4: 通货膨胀让东西变贵了。
column5: 通貨膨脹讓東西變貴了。
column6: Tōnghuò péngzhàng ràng dōngxi biàn guì le.
column7: Inflation makes things more expensive.
column9: To expand, to swell: 通貨膨脹 "inflation", 膨脹的氣球 "a swelling balloon", and for pride: 自信心膨脹. Both characters have 月 "flesh" on the left, which fits swelling. 膨's sound part 彭 is read péng, the same.

column3: Leaning, off to one side: 偏左, 偏高 "on the high side", 偏远 "remote". As an adverb it is "stubbornly, just to spite": 你不让我去，我偏要去. 亻 "person" is the meaning part and 扁 gives the sound (piān, close). The doubled 偏偏 has a note of its own.
column6: Zhège fángjiān piān xiǎo.
column7: This room is on the small side.
column9: Leaning, off to one side: 偏左, 偏高 "on the high side", 偏遠 "remote". As an adverb it is "stubbornly, just to spite": 你不讓我去，我偏要去. 亻 "person" is the meaning part and 扁 gives the sound (piān, close). The doubled 偏偏 has a note of its own.

column3: Of all things, just then: it marks that events turn out the opposite of what the speaker wanted: 我一出门，偏偏下起雨来. It also shows stubbornness: 偏偏要这样做, "insist on doing it", and singles someone out: 为什么偏偏是我？ "why me, of all people?". It is spoken and has a complaint in it.
column6: Wǒ gāng chūmén, piānpiān xiàyǔ le.
column7: Just as I went out, of all times, it started to rain.
column9: Of all things, just then: it marks that events turn out the opposite of what the speaker wanted: 我一出門，偏偏下起雨來. It also shows stubbornness: 偏偏要這樣做, "insist on doing it", and singles someone out: 為什麼偏偏是我？ "why me, of all people?". It is spoken and has a complaint in it.

column3: Picky eating, being partial to some foods: 小孩偏食 "the child is a picky eater", 偏食不好. 偏 "lean to one side" + 食 "food", eating from one side only. It means a bad habit of not eating some kinds of food, often vegetables.
column6: Háizi piānshí, bù chī qīngcài.
column7: The child is a picky eater and doesn't eat green vegetables.
column9: Picky eating, being partial to some foods: 小孩偏食 "the child is a picky eater", 偏食不好. 偏 "lean to one side" + 食 "food", eating from one side only. It means a bad habit of not eating some kinds of food, often vegetables.

column3: To lean toward, to favor: 我偏向选这个 "I lean toward choosing this one", 偏向某一方 "take someone's side". It is for preference or tendency, and in a complaint it means unfair favoring. 偏 "to one side" + 向 "toward".
column6: Wǒ piānxiàng mǎi piányi yīdiǎn de.
column7: I lean toward buying the cheaper one.
column9: To lean toward, to favor: 我偏向選這個 "I lean toward choosing this one", 偏向某一方 "take someone's side". It is for preference or tendency, and in a complaint it means unfair favoring. 偏 "to one side" + 向 "toward".

column3: Film, movie in speech, and "a thin slice": 看片子 "watch a film", 一部片子, 好片子. 片子 is a casual word for a movie or a disc, and 电影 is the neutral word. 片 "slice" + 子, a suffix that is neutral in tone. The thin piece is the older sense.
column6: Zhè bù piānzi hěn hǎokàn.
column7: This film is really good.
column9: Film, movie in speech, and "a thin slice": 看片子 "watch a film", 一部片子, 好片子. 片子 is a casual word for a movie or a disc, and 電影 is the neutral word. 片 "slice" + 子, a suffix that is neutral in tone. The thin piece is the older sense.

column3: To float, to drift in the air: 雪花飘下来 "snowflakes drift down", 飘着香味, 飘扬 "flutter" of a flag. 风 "wind" is the meaning part, and 票 gives the sound (piào, close to piāo). Things that the wind carries.
column6: Shùyè zài fēng zhōng piāo zhe.
column7: The leaves drift in the wind.
column9: To float, to drift in the air: 雪花飄下來 "snowflakes drift down", 飄著香味, 飄揚 "flutter" of a flag. 風 "wind" is the meaning part, and 票 gives the sound (piào, close to piāo). Things that the wind carries.

column3: Buttocks, bottom: 打屁股 "spank", 摔到屁股. It is the everyday word and a bit rude in formal talk. The second syllable is neutral. 屁 "a fart" has 尸 "body" as its top part and 比 as the sound. Also used for the back end of things, such as 车屁股.
column6: Tā shuāi le yī jiāo, pìgu hěn tòng.
column7: He fell and his bottom hurts.
column9: Buttocks, bottom: 打屁股 "spank", 摔到屁股. It is the everyday word and a bit rude in formal talk. The second syllable is neutral. 屁 "a fart" has 尸 "body" as its top part and 比 as the sound. Also used for the back end of things, such as 車屁股.

column3: Tired, weary, for the feeling of the whole body or the mind: 感到疲倦 "feel tired", 疲倦的脸. A little more literary than 累, and suits long-lasting tiredness. 疲 has 疒 "sickness" and 皮; 倦 has 亻 "person" and 卷 "curl", a person who curls up with fatigue.
column6: Liánxù gōngzuò hòu tā hěn píjuàn.
column7: After working nonstop he is very tired.
column9: Tired, weary, for the feeling of the whole body or the mind: 感到疲倦 "feel tired", 疲倦的臉. A little more literary than 累, and suits long-lasting tiredness. 疲 has 疒 "sickness" and 皮; 倦 has 亻 "person" and 卷 "curl", a person who curls up with fatigue.

column3: Fatigue: 疲劳驾驶 "driving while tired", 视觉疲劳 "eye strain", 消除疲劳. It is a noun for a state and the word of warnings and health talk. 疲 "tired" + 劳 "labor". It speaks of tiredness from work or effort, built up over time.
column6: Píláo jiàshǐ hěn wēixiǎn.
column7: Driving while tired is dangerous.
column9: Fatigue: 疲勞駕駛 "driving while tired", 視覺疲勞 "eye strain", 消除疲勞. It is a noun for a state and the word of warnings and health talk. 疲 "tired" + 勞 "labor". It speaks of tiredness from work or effort, built up over time.

column3: Moral character: 品德高尚 "of high moral character", 品德教育 "moral education" in schools. 品 "quality" + 德 "virtue". It is about a person's conduct and values, and is a written word used in schools and recommendations.
column4: 老师很重视学生的品德。
column5: 老師很重視學生的品德。
column6: Lǎoshī hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de pǐndé.
column7: The teacher cares a lot about students' character.
column9: Moral character: 品德高尚 "of high moral character", 品德教育 "moral education" in schools. 品 "quality" + 德 "virtue". It is about a person's conduct and values, and is a written word used in schools and recommendations.

column3: Balance: 保持平衡 "keep balance", 失去平衡 "lose balance", 收支平衡 "income and spending balanced". It is used for the body and for abstract things such as work and life: 工作与生活的平衡. 平 "level" + 衡 "weigh", where 衡 once meant a balance beam with a horn on it. It can be a verb: 平衡一下.
column6: Qí jiǎotàchē yào bǎochí pínghéng.
column7: You have to keep your balance when riding a bicycle.
column9: Balance: 保持平衡 "keep balance", 失去平衡 "lose balance", 收支平衡 "income and spending balanced". It is used for the body and for abstract things such as work and life: 工作與生活的平衡. 平 "level" + 衡 "weigh", where 衡 once meant a balance beam with a horn on it. It can be a verb: 平衡一下.

column3: Table tennis, ping-pong: 打乒乓球, and also the little ball. 乒乓 imitates the sound of the ball and both characters show a ball bouncing back and forth. In Taiwan 桌球 is the usual name for the sport, and 乒乓球 for the ball or for a game played for fun.
column6: Tāmen zài dǎ pīngpāngqiú.
column7: They are playing table tennis.
column9: Table tennis, ping-pong: 打乒乓球, and also the little ball. 乒乓 imitates the sound of the ball and both characters show a ball bouncing back and forth. In Taiwan 桌球 is the usual name for the sport, and 乒乓球 for the ball or for a game played for fun.

column3: Table tennis, Taiwan's usual name for the sport: 打桌球, 桌球比赛. 桌 "table" + 球 "ball". 乒乓球 is the same game and also the ball itself. The word also means billiards in Hong Kong and some places, but in Taiwan billiards is 撞球 and 桌球 is table tennis.
column6: Wǒ gēge xǐhuān dǎ zhuōqiú.
column7: My older brother likes to play table tennis.
column9: Table tennis, Taiwan's usual name for the sport: 打桌球, 桌球比賽. 桌 "table" + 球 "ball". 乒乓球 is the same game and also the ball itself. The word also means billiards in Hong Kong and some places, but in Taiwan billiards is 撞球 and 桌球 is table tennis.

column3: With all one's might, desperately: 拼命工作 "work flat out", 拼命跑 "run for dear life", 拼命道歉. It goes before a verb and shows effort to the limit, almost risking one's life: 命 is "life". 拼 "put together, go all out".
column6: Tā pīnmìng de pǎo xiàng chēzhàn.
column7: He ran to the station as hard as he could.
column9: With all one's might, desperately: 拼命工作 "work flat out", 拼命跑 "run for dear life", 拼命道歉. It goes before a verb and shows effort to the limit, almost risking one's life: 命 is "life". 拼 "put together, go all out".

column3: To hire, to engage a professional, a teacher or an expert, with some formality: 聘请律师 "hire a lawyer", 聘请专家. The person is hired for their skill, and the employer is a school, company or family. 聘 has 耳 "ear" and 甹 as the sound. The form 聘用 is also used for hiring.
column4: 公司聘请了一位新律师。
column5: 公司聘請了一位新律師。
column6: Gōngsī pìnqǐng le yī wèi xīn lǜshī.
column7: The company hired a new lawyer.
column9: To hire, to engage a professional, a teacher or an expert, with some formality: 聘請律師 "hire a lawyer", 聘請專家. The person is hired for their skill, and the employer is a school, company or family. 聘 has 耳 "ear" and 甹 as the sound. The form 聘用 is also used for hiring.

column3: Poor, in poverty: 贫穷的家庭, 摆脱贫穷 "escape poverty". Both characters mean poor, and the word is a state of being short of money and means. It is the written word; in speech people say 穷 alone. 贫 shows 贝 "money" under 分 "divide", money divided up until little is left.
column6: Tā xiǎoshíhou jiālǐ hěn pínqióng.
column7: His family was very poor when he was little.
column9: Poor, in poverty: 貧窮的家庭, 擺脫貧窮 "escape poverty". Both characters mean poor, and the word is a state of being short of money and means. It is the written word; in speech people say 窮 alone. 貧 shows 貝 "money" under 分 "divide", money divided up until little is left.

column3: Poor, lacking: it is mostly in compounds: 贫穷, 贫血 "anemia", 贫富 "rich and poor", 清贫 "poor but honest". It is not used alone as an adjective in speech. 贝 "money" and 分 "divide": money divided away. 分 is also the sound, fen to pin, only roughly alike.
column6: Pínfù chājù yuèláiyuè dà.
column7: The gap between rich and poor keeps growing.
column9: Poor, lacking: it is mostly in compounds: 貧窮, 貧血 "anemia", 貧富 "rich and poor", 清貧 "poor but honest". It is not used alone as an adjective in speech. 貝 "money" and 分 "divide": money divided away. 分 is also the sound, fen to pin, only roughly alike.

column3: To criticize, to critique, seriously and in public: 批判政府, 受到批判. It is stronger and more formal than 批评, with a judgment of what is wrong at its core. 批 "comment" + 判 "judge". Used of ideas, policies and behavior of a group more than of one person's slip.
column4: 这篇文章批判了社会问题。
column5: 這篇文章批判了社會問題。
column6: Zhè piān wénzhāng pīpàn le shèhuì wèntí.
column7: This article criticizes problems in society.
column9: To criticize, to critique, seriously and in public: 批判政府, 受到批判. It is stronger and more formal than 批評, with a judgment of what is wrong at its core. 批 "comment" + 判 "judge". Used of ideas, policies and behavior of a group more than of one person's slip.

column3: Rather, quite, an adverb of degree, written in more formal style: 颇有名 "rather famous", 颇为满意 "quite satisfied", 颇有道理. It goes before an adjective or a verb with 有. In Taiwan it is read pǒ. The dictionary's other reading is pō, as in 偏颇 "biased".
column6: Zhè jiā cāntīng pō yǒumíng.
column7: This restaurant is quite well known.
column9: Rather, quite, an adverb of degree, written in more formal style: 頗有名 "rather famous", 頗為滿意 "quite satisfied", 頗有道理. It goes before an adjective or a verb with 有. In Taiwan it is read pǒ. The dictionary's other reading is pō, as in 偏頗 "biased".

column3: Worn-out, tattered, and "junk, rubbish": 破烂的衣服 "tattered clothes", 收破烂 "collect junk". 破 "broken" + 烂 "rotten". It is about things in poor shape, such as clothes, a car or a house. It looks down on its object.
column4: 他穿着一件破烂的外套。
column5: 他穿著一件破爛的外套。
column6: Tā chuān zhe yī jiàn pòlàn de wàitào.
column7: He wore a tattered coat.
column9: Worn-out, tattered, and "junk, rubbish": 破爛的衣服 "tattered clothes", 收破爛 "collect junk". 破 "broken" + 爛 "rotten". It is about things in poor shape, such as clothes, a car or a house. It looks down on its object.

column3: To burst, to rupture, and for relations "to break down": 血管破裂 "a blood vessel ruptures", 谈判破裂 "talks break down", 关系破裂. 破 "broken" + 裂 "split". It is for things that give way along a line or at a point.
column6: Liǎng guó de tánpàn pòliè le.
column7: The talks between the two countries broke down.
column9: To burst, to rupture, and for relations "to break down": 血管破裂 "a blood vessel ruptures", 談判破裂 "talks break down", 關係破裂. 破 "broken" + 裂 "split". It is for things that give way along a line or at a point.

column3: Mother-in-law from the wife's side, her husband's mother: 我婆婆. The second 婆 is neutral. 婆 is 女 "woman" with 波 for the sound (bō, close to pó). The same word is used for an old woman, kindly: "granny". A husband's mother is 婆婆, and a wife's mother is 岳母.
column6: Wǒ pópo zhù zài Táinán.
column7: My mother-in-law lives in Tainan.
column9: Mother-in-law from the wife's side, her husband's mother: 我婆婆. The second 婆 is neutral. 婆 is 女 "woman" with 波 for the sound (bō, close to pó). The same word is used for an old woman, kindly: "granny". A husband's mother is 婆婆, and a wife's mother is 岳母.

column3: To throw oneself at, to pounce on, and "to beat, to flap": 扑向 "rush toward", 扑过来, 扑克 "playing cards" (a loan from "poker"; the 克 is for the sound), 扑了个空 "grab at nothing". The hand 扌 is the meaning part. A dog or a child that jumps at someone does it.
column6: Xiǎogǒu pū dào wǒ shēnshang.
column7: The puppy jumped onto me.
column9: To throw oneself at, to pounce on, and "to beat, to flap": 撲向 "rush toward", 撲過來, 撲克 "playing cards" (a loan from "poker"; the 克 is for the sound), 撲了個空 "grab at nothing". The hand 扌 is the meaning part. A dog or a child that jumps at someone does it.

column3: To spread out, to lay: 铺床 "make the bed", 铺桌布 "spread a tablecloth", 铺地毯, 铺路 "pave a road". As a verb it is pū; the noun "shop" is pù, as in 店铺. 钅 "metal" is the left part and 甫 gives the sound (fǔ, close to pū).
column6: Qǐng bāng wǒ pū chuáng.
column7: Please help me make the bed.
column9: To spread out, to lay: 鋪床 "make the bed", 鋪桌布 "spread a tablecloth", 鋪地毯, 鋪路 "pave a road". As a verb it is pū; the noun "shop" is pù, as in 店鋪. 釒 "metal" is the left part and 甫 gives the sound (fǔ, close to pū).

column3: Waterfall: 一座瀑布, 看瀑布. 十分瀑布 in New Taipei is a famous one. 瀑 has 氵 "water" and 暴 "violent, sudden", which gives both the sound (bào, close to pù) and a hint of how the water falls. 布 "cloth" is the second part: the water hangs like a sheet of cloth.
column4: 山里有一座很高的瀑布。
column5: 山裡有一座很高的瀑布。
column6: Shān lǐ yǒu yī zuò hěn gāo de pùbù.
column7: There is a very tall waterfall in the mountains.
column9: Waterfall: 一座瀑布, 看瀑布. 十分瀑布 in New Taipei is a famous one. 瀑 has 氵 "water" and 暴 "violent, sudden", which gives both the sound (bào, close to pù) and a hint of how the water falls. 布 "cloth" is the second part: the water hangs like a sheet of cloth.

column3: To put out, to stamp out, of fire or of something that spreads: 扑灭火灾 "put out a fire", 扑灭疫情 "stamp out an outbreak", 扑灭害虫. 扑 "beat down" + 灭 "extinguish". It is a written, newspaper word and means ending something by force.
column4: 消防员很快扑灭了大火。
column5: 消防員很快撲滅了大火。
column6: Xiāofángyuán hěn kuài pūmiè le dàhuǒ.
column7: The firefighters quickly put out the big fire.
column9: To put out, to stamp out, of fire or of something that spreads: 撲滅火災 "put out a fire", 撲滅疫情 "stamp out an outbreak", 撲滅害蟲. 撲 "beat down" + 滅 "extinguish". It is a written, newspaper word and means ending something by force.

column3: Chess, board game, and a game piece: 下棋 "play chess", 象棋 "Chinese chess", 围棋 "go", 棋子 "piece". The verb for playing is 下, as in 下棋. 木 "wood" is the meaning part, since the pieces were wooden, and 其 gives the sound (qí, the same).
column6: Yéye xǐhuān xià qí.
column7: Grandpa likes to play chess.
column9: Chess, board game, and a game piece: 下棋 "play chess", 象棋 "Chinese chess", 圍棋 "go", 棋子 "piece". The verb for playing is 下, as in 下棋. 木 "wood" is the meaning part, since the pieces were wooden, and 其 gives the sound (qí, the same).

column3: Flag, banner: 国旗 "national flag", 升旗 "raise the flag", 旗杆 "flagpole", 红旗. The left part 方 stands for the old flag character 㫃, and 其 gives the sound (qí, the same). It is the first part of 旗袍 and 旗子.
column6: Xuéxiào měitiān zǎoshang shēng qí.
column7: The school raises the flag every morning.
column9: Flag, banner: 國旗 "national flag", 升旗 "raise the flag", 旗桿 "flagpole", 紅旗. The left part 方 stands for the old flag character 㫃, and 其 gives the sound (qí, the same). It is the first part of 旗袍 and 旗子.

column3: Flag, banner, the everyday word: 一面旗子 "a flag", 挥旗子 "wave a flag". 旗 + the neutral suffix 子. The classifier is 面. 旗 alone is for compounds such as 国旗; 旗子 is for the thing in your hand or on a pole.
column6: Háizimen huī zhe xiǎo qízi.
column7: The children are waving little flags.
column9: Flag, banner, the everyday word: 一面旗子 "a flag", 揮旗子 "wave a flag". 旗 + the neutral suffix 子. The classifier is 面. 旗 alone is for compounds such as 國旗; 旗子 is for the thing in your hand or on a pole.

column3: Wife, only in compounds and formal speech: 妻子, 夫妻 "husband and wife", 妻儿 "wife and children", 未婚妻 "fiancée". It is a bound form, so in speech you say 我太太 or 我老婆, not 我妻. 女 "woman" is at the bottom.
column6: Tā hé qīzi yīqǐ lái le.
column7: He came together with his wife.
column9: Wife, only in compounds and formal speech: 妻子, 夫妻 "husband and wife", 妻兒 "wife and children", 未婚妻 "fiancée". It is a bound form, so in speech you say 我太太 or 我老婆, not 我妻. 女 "woman" is at the bottom.

column3: To lead along, to pull: 牵手 "hold hands", 牵狗 "walk a dog", 牵着小孩, 牵车 "wheel a bike". The picture is a person leading an ox 牛 by a rope. And in compounds, "to involve": 牵涉, 牵连. In Taiwan 牵手 also means "spouse".
column6: Tā qiān zhe gǒu zài gōngyuán sànbù.
column7: He is walking his dog in the park.
column9: To lead along, to pull: 牽手 "hold hands", 牽狗 "walk a dog", 牽著小孩, 牽車 "wheel a bike". The picture is a person leading an ox 牛 by a rope. And in compounds, "to involve": 牽涉, 牽連. In Taiwan 牽手 also means "spouse".

column3: To move, to relocate: 搬迁 "move house", 迁移 "migrate", 迁居, 迁都 "move the capital", and "to be promoted" in 升迁. It is a formal verb, mostly in compounds, with 辶 "walk" for the meaning. 搬家 is the spoken word for moving house.
column6: Tāmen jiā bānqiān dào Táizhōng le.
column7: Their family has moved to Taichung.
column9: To move, to relocate: 搬遷 "move house", 遷移 "migrate", 遷居, 遷都 "move the capital", and "to be promoted" in 升遷. It is a formal verb, mostly in compounds, with 辶 "walk" for the meaning. 搬家 is the spoken word for moving house.

column3: Ahead, the front: 前方有车 "there is a car ahead", 前方施工 "roadworks ahead". On signs and in directions, and for a front line in war. 前 "front" + 方 "direction, side". It is more formal than 前面 and more about a place seen from a distance.
column4: 前方有一辆车停在路中间。
column5: 前方有一輛車停在路中間。
column6: Qiánfāng yǒu yī liàng chē tíng zài lù zhōngjiān.
column7: There is a car stopped in the middle of the road ahead.
column9: Ahead, the front: 前方有車 "there is a car ahead", 前方施工 "roadworks ahead". On signs and in directions, and for a front line in war. 前 "front" + 方 "direction, side". It is more formal than 前面 and more about a place seen from a distance.

column3: A strongman in politics, and "a very capable person" at work: 女强人 "a woman who has made it in her career", 政治强人. The sense of a capable woman is the common one. 强 "strong" + 人 "person". The old sense of "bandit" belongs to old novels.
column6: Tā shì gōngsī lǐ de nǚ qiángrén.
column7: She is a powerful career woman at the company.
column9: A strongman in politics, and "a very capable person" at work: 女強人 "a woman who has made it in her career", 政治強人. The sense of a capable woman is the common one. 強 "strong" + 人 "person". The old sense of "bandit" belongs to old novels.

column3: Apology, regret: 表示歉意 "express regret", 深感歉意 "feel deeply sorry". It is a written, polite word and the feeling behind the apology. 歉 "apologetic" + 意 "meaning, feeling". The common set phrase is 向你表示歉意. 欠 "lack" is the meaning part, shared by 歉; you feel that you owe something.
column6: Wǒ duì cǐ shēn biǎo qiànyì.
column7: I am deeply sorry for this.
column9: Apology, regret: 表示歉意 "express regret", 深感歉意 "feel deeply sorry". It is a written, polite word and the feeling behind the apology. 歉 "apologetic" + 意 "meaning, feeling". The common set phrase is 向你表示歉意. 欠 "lack" is the meaning part, shared by 歉; you feel that you owe something.

column3: Front yard, front courtyard: 房子的前院 "the front yard of the house", 前院种着花. 前 "front" + 院 "yard, courtyard". The back yard is 后院.
column4: 他家的前院种了很多花。
column5: 他家的前院種了很多花。
column6: Tā jiā de qiányuàn zhòng le hěn duō huā.
column7: The front yard of his house is planted with lots of flowers.
column9: Front yard, front courtyard: 房子的前院 "the front yard of the house", 前院種著花. 前 "front" + 院 "yard, courtyard". The back yard is 後院.

column3: Ingenious, clever, for a method, a design or a way of speaking: 巧妙的办法 "an ingenious way", 巧妙地回答 "answer cleverly". 巧 "skillful" + 妙 "marvelous". The cleverness is one that solves a problem neatly, not craftiness.
column4: 他巧妙地解决了这个问题。
column5: 他巧妙地解決了這個問題。
column6: Tā qiǎomiào de jiějué le zhège wèntí.
column7: He solved the problem cleverly.
column9: Ingenious, clever, for a method, a design or a way of speaking: 巧妙的辦法 "an ingenious way", 巧妙地回答 "answer cleverly". 巧 "skillful" + 妙 "marvelous". The cleverness is one that solves a problem neatly, not craftiness.

column3: Quiet, softly: it is found doubled in 悄悄 "quietly, secretly", 悄悄话 "whispered words", and in 悄然 "quietly". The doubled word is usually said qiāoqiāo, while the dictionary lists 悄 itself as qiǎo. 忄 "heart" is the meaning part and 肖 gives a sound (xiāo, close to qiāo).
column6: Tā qiāoqiāo de zǒujìn fángjiān.
column7: He walked quietly into the room.
column9: Quiet, softly: it is found doubled in 悄悄 "quietly, secretly", 悄悄話 "whispered words", and in 悄然 "quietly". The doubled word is usually said qiāoqiāo, while the dictionary lists 悄 itself as qiǎo. 忄 "heart" is the meaning part and 肖 gives a sound (xiāo, close to qiāo).

column3: Equipment, materials for a specific activity: 运动器材 "sports equipment", 摄影器材 "camera gear", 实验器材. 器 "utensil, device" + 材 "material". It names the tools and gear used in a sport or a job, not furniture.
column4: 健身房里有很多运动器材。
column5: 健身房裡有很多運動器材。
column6: Jiànshēnfáng lǐ yǒu hěn duō yùndòng qìcái.
column7: The gym has a lot of sports equipment.
column9: Equipment, materials for a specific activity: 運動器材 "sports equipment", 攝影器材 "camera gear", 實驗器材. 器 "utensil, device" + 材 "material". It names the tools and gear used in a sport or a job, not furniture.

column3: At first, originally: 起初我不习惯 "at first I wasn't used to it". It begins the story of a change and is followed by 后来 "later": 起初…后来…. 起 "start" + 初 "beginning". Not used for a plan about the future.
column4: 起初我不习惯这里的天气。
column5: 起初我不習慣這裡的天氣。
column6: Qǐchū wǒ bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
column7: At first I wasn't used to the weather here.
column9: At first, originally: 起初我不習慣 "at first I wasn't used to it". It begins the story of a change and is followed by 後來 "later": 起初…後來…. 起 "start" + 初 "beginning". Not used for a plan about the future.

column3: Indignant, furious, for anger at something unfair: 非常气愤 "very angry", 令人气愤 "outrageous". 气 "air, temper" + 愤 "resent". It is stronger than 生气 and the cause is usually injustice or an insult, not a small annoyance.
column4: 听到这个消息，他非常气愤。
column5: 聽到這個消息，他非常氣憤。
column6: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā fēicháng qìfèn.
column7: When he heard the news he was furious.
column9: Indignant, furious, for anger at something unfair: 非常氣憤 "very angry", 令人氣憤 "outrageous". 氣 "air, temper" + 憤 "resent". It is stronger than 生氣 and the cause is usually injustice or an insult, not a small annoyance.

column3: Atmosphere, mood of a place or a gathering: 气氛很好, 热闹的气氛, 紧张的气氛, 活跃气氛. It is how the room feels. 气 "air" + 氛, which means "vapor, mist" and is only used in this word and 氛围. A party, a meeting or a restaurant has it.
column6: Cāntīng lǐ de qìfēn hěn qīngsōng.
column7: The atmosphere in the restaurant is relaxed.
column9: Atmosphere, mood of a place or a gathering: 氣氛很好, 熱鬧的氣氛, 緊張的氣氛, 活躍氣氛. It is how the room feels. 氣 "air" + 氛, which means "vapor, mist" and is only used in this word and 氛圍. A party, a meeting or a restaurant has it.

column3: To catch fire, of a building or a vehicle: 房子起火了, 起火原因 "the cause of the fire". It is the word of news reports. It can also be said when someone starts to cook or gets angry, but the fire is the sense meant here. 起 "start" + 火 "fire".
column4: 昨晚附近的工厂起火了。
column5: 昨晚附近的工廠起火了。
column6: Zuówǎn fùjìn de gōngchǎng qǐhuǒ le.
column7: A factory nearby caught fire last night.
column9: To catch fire, of a building or a vehicle: 房子起火了, 起火原因 "the cause of the fire". It is the word of news reports. It can also be said when someone starts to cook or gets angry, but the fire is the sense meant here. 起 "start" + 火 "fire".

column3: To clear away, to get rid of: 清除垃圾 "clear out rubbish", 清除障碍 "remove obstacles", 清除病毒. The thing is cleaned out completely. 清 "clean, clear" + 除 "remove". Used for rubbish, snow, files and abstract problems.
column4: 工人正在清除路上的积雪。
column5: 工人正在清除路上的積雪。
column6: Gōngrén zhèngzài qīngchú lùshàng de jīxuě.
column7: Workers are clearing the snow off the road.
column9: To clear away, to get rid of: 清除垃圾 "clear out rubbish", 清除障礙 "remove obstacles", 清除病毒. The thing is cleaned out completely. 清 "clean, clear" + 除 "remove". Used for rubbish, snow, files and abstract problems.

column3: Light, mild, for food that is not oily or strongly seasoned: 清淡的菜 "light dishes", 口味清淡 "likes mild flavors". It is what doctors recommend: 饮食清淡. 清 "clear" + 淡 "weak, light". Also for color and for business that is slow.
column4: 生病的时候要吃清淡的东西。
column5: 生病的時候要吃清淡的東西。
column6: Shēngbìng de shíhou yào chī qīngdàn de dōngxi.
column7: When you are ill you should eat light food.
column9: Light, mild, for food that is not oily or strongly seasoned: 清淡的菜 "light dishes", 口味清淡 "likes mild flavors". It is what doctors recommend: 飲食清淡. 清 "clear" + 淡 "weak, light". Also for color and for business that is slow.

column3: Minor injury: 轻伤, with 重伤 "serious injury": 他只受了轻伤 "he was only slightly hurt". News reports about accidents use it for the count of people hurt: 两人轻伤. 轻 "light" + 伤 "wound". It is used for people hurt, not for damage to things.
column4: 这次车祸只有两个人受了轻伤。
column5: 這次車禍只有兩個人受了輕傷。
column6: Zhè cì chēhuò zhǐyǒu liǎng ge rén shòu le qīngshāng.
column7: Only two people were slightly hurt in the accident.
column9: Minor injury: 輕傷, with 重傷 "serious injury": 他只受了輕傷 "he was only slightly hurt". News reports about accidents use it for the count of people hurt: 兩人輕傷. 輕 "light" + 傷 "wound". It is used for people hurt, not for damage to things.

column3: To look down on, to underestimate: 轻视对手 "underestimate the opponent", 不能轻视 "must not be taken lightly". 轻 "light" + 视 "regard". It means treating someone or something as of little weight, and can be contempt or just carelessness.
column4: 不要轻视任何一个对手。
column5: 不要輕視任何一個對手。
column6: Bù yào qīngshì rènhé yī ge duìshǒu.
column7: Don't underestimate any opponent.
column9: To look down on, to underestimate: 輕視對手 "underestimate the opponent", 不能輕視 "must not be taken lightly". 輕 "light" + 視 "regard". It means treating someone or something as of little weight, and can be contempt or just carelessness.

column3: Love letter: 写情书 "write a love letter", 一封情书. 情 "feeling" + 书 "letter, writing". The measure is 封, as for any letter. Nowadays it may also be a message, but the word keeps the old, handwritten picture.
column6: Tā gěi tā xiě le yī fēng qíngshū.
column7: He wrote her a love letter.
column9: Love letter: 寫情書 "write a love letter", 一封情書. 情 "feeling" + 書 "letter, writing". The measure is 封, as for any letter. Nowadays it may also be a message, but the word keeps the old, handwritten picture.

column3: Clear, distinct, for a picture, a sound or an idea: 画面清晰, 声音清晰, 思路清晰 "a clear line of thought". 清 "clear" + 晰 "distinct", where 晰 has 日 "sun" for brightness. It is written and a touch formal; 清楚 is the spoken word.
column6: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn pāi de hěn qīngxī.
column7: This photo is very sharp.
column9: Clear, distinct, for a picture, a sound or an idea: 畫面清晰, 聲音清晰, 思路清晰 "a clear line of thought". 清 "clear" + 晰 "distinct", where 晰 has 日 "sun" for brightness. It is written and a touch formal; 清楚 is the spoken word.

column3: Tendency, trend, and "to lean toward": 有…的倾向 "have a tendency to", 倾向于 "lean toward", 政治倾向. 倾 "lean, tilt" + 向 "toward". Used for a pattern of behavior or a view: 他有暴力倾向. The verb takes 于.
column6: Tā yǒu tuōyán de qīngxiàng.
column7: He has a tendency to put things off.
column9: Tendency, trend, and "to lean toward": 有…的傾向 "have a tendency to", 傾向於 "lean toward", 政治傾向. 傾 "lean, tilt" + 向 "toward". Used for a pattern of behavior or a view: 他有暴力傾向. The verb takes 於.

column3: Mood, emotional state: 情绪不好 "in a bad mood", 控制情绪, 情绪化 "moody". It points to feelings that come and go, anger, sadness, anxiety. 情 "feeling" + 绪, which has 纟 "thread" for the meaning and 者 for the sound (zhě, not close to xù).
column6: Tā jīntiān qíngxù bù tài hǎo.
column7: He is not in a good mood today.
column9: Mood, emotional state: 情緒不好 "in a bad mood", 控制情緒, 情緒化 "moody". It points to feelings that come and go, anger, sadness, anxiety. 情 "feeling" + 緒, which has 糹 "thread" for the meaning and 者 for the sound (zhě, not close to xù).

column3: To encroach on, to infringe: 侵害权利 "infringe on rights", 侵害隐私, 受到侵害. 侵 "invade" + 害 "harm". The object is a right, an interest or a person's body. It is the word of law and news. 侵 has 亻 "person" and a hand with a broom.
column4: 这样做侵害了别人的隐私。
column5: 這樣做侵害了別人的隱私。
column6: Zhèyàng zuò qīnhài le biérén de yǐnsī.
column7: Doing this infringes on other people's privacy.
column9: To encroach on, to infringe: 侵害權利 "infringe on rights", 侵害隱私, 受到侵害. 侵 "invade" + 害 "harm". The object is a right, an interest or a person's body. It is the word of law and news. 侵 has 亻 "person" and a hand with a broom.

column3: In one's own words, with one's own mouth: 亲口说 "say it personally", 亲口告诉我 "tell me himself". 亲 "personally" + 口 "mouth". It stresses that the person said it, not a rumor: 我亲口听他说的. It goes before verbs of speaking or tasting: 亲口尝一尝.
column6: Zhè shì tā qīnkǒu gàosu wǒ de.
column7: He told me this himself.
column9: In one's own words, with one's own mouth: 親口說 "say it personally", 親口告訴我 "tell me himself". 親 "personally" + 口 "mouth". It stresses that the person said it, not a rumor: 我親口聽他說的. It goes before verbs of speaking or tasting: 親口嘗一嘗.

column3: Hardworking, industrious: 勤劳的人 "a hardworking person", 勤劳的农夫, 勤劳致富. A word of praise and a bit formal, for working steadily and without complaint, as for farmers or a mother. 勤 "diligent" + 劳 "labor". 勤劳 is about the habit, and 努力 is about a push.
column6: Tā shì yī ge qínláo de nóngfū.
column7: He is a hardworking farmer.
column9: Hardworking, industrious: 勤勞的人 "a hardworking person", 勤勞的農夫, 勤勞致富. A word of praise and a bit formal, for working steadily and without complaint, as for farmers or a mother. 勤 "diligent" + 勞 "labor". 勤勞 is about the habit, and 努力 is about a push.

column3: Relative: 亲戚 are the family beyond your household: 走亲戚 "visit relatives", 亲戚朋友. 亲 "close" + 戚 "relatives"; the second syllable is neutral. In the New Year, people visit 亲戚. For a specific one you say the title, such as 舅舅.
column4: 过年的时候我们去看亲戚。
column5: 過年的時候我們去看親戚。
column6: Guònián de shíhou wǒmen qù kàn qīnqi.
column7: At New Year we go to see our relatives.
column9: Relative: 親戚 are the family beyond your household: 走親戚 "visit relatives", 親戚朋友. 親 "close" + 戚 "relatives"; the second syllable is neutral. In the New Year, people visit 親戚. For a specific one you say the title, such as 舅舅.

column3: To invade, to intrude into: 侵入他国领土 "enter another country's territory", 侵入电脑系统 "break into a computer system", 侵入住宅. It means entering where one has no right. 侵 "invade" + 入 "enter". It is in news and legal texts.
column4: 有人侵入了公司的电脑系统。
column5: 有人侵入了公司的電腦系統。
column6: Yǒu rén qīnrù le gōngsī de diànnǎo xìtǒng.
column7: Someone broke into the company's computer system.
column9: To invade, to intrude into: 侵入他國領土 "enter another country's territory", 侵入電腦系統 "break into a computer system", 侵入住宅. It means entering where one has no right. 侵 "invade" + 入 "enter". It is in news and legal texts.
